meta.summary: Look up a member and return the balance of one of their accounts.

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: Which account's balance to read, as labelled on the member profile

outputs.name: balance
outputs.description: Current balance of the requested account, as a decimal string

target.rationale: Field has no accessible name; anchored to its label's innermost table row. Position fallback is fragile and logged as drift if used.
Button has its own accessible name from its visible label.

steps.intent: Read the balance for the requested account type

target.description: Balance cell for the requested account type
target.rationale: Found by meaning (account type row x Balance column), never by position: account order differs between members.

member_not_found.description: No member exists with this ID.

invalid_member_id.description: The application rejected the member ID format.

member_restricted.description: The member's account requires supervisor access.

provenance.discovered_by: hand-authored for replay development (to be compared with an LLM-discovered version)
provenance.goal: Look up member {{inputs.member_id}} and read their savings balance
